title: Multiparametric evaluation of orthopedic and radiological measurements on X-ray images and cross-sectional imaging data, comparing manual and software-based automated methods.
summary:
This study examines how accurate measurements on X-ray images of the body are. Until now, these measurements have been performed manually by doctors. New computer programs can perform these tasks automatically.

The aim of the study is to determine whether the automated results are just as reliable as the manual ones. To this end, existing, anonymized image data from recent years will be analyzed and compared.
conditions: Diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue

interventions.name: Following a systematic search, suitable radiological examinations from the period 2015 to 2023 are pseudonymized and then fully anonymized. The image data will be transferred to a randomized evaluation list and analyzed both manually by blinded examiners and automatically using AI software. Standard

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who, between July 2015 and December 1, 2025, underwent a radiological examination 
at LMU Medical Center to assess the alignment of the musculoskeletal system as part of routine clinical practice.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with poor image quality.
